claims.text: Reviewers commonly use these clips for sectioning hair while coloring, blow drying, and styling, and report they hold hair well.
Several reviewers praise the clips as sturdy and durable, noting they don't break, slip, or tangle easily.
Multiple reviewers were disappointed to receive a mix of black and white clips when the listing showed only black.
Some reviewers note the clips may not hold large amounts of hair or hold as tightly as desired, and the teeth are short for thick hair.
A few reviewers mention the clips can snap if stepped on or used roughly.
